description: Automerge: grouped patch PRs and minor PRs merge once the required commit check passes (ruleset). Merging only changes main; images are built when the operator runs the build. RKE2 patch updates wait 3 days. RKE2 minor and major updates open only after the owner approves them on the dependency dashboard.

packageRules.description: The platform takes each Cilium release first. This image only needs a working boot-time CNI, so it waits 14 days longer than the platform's rule.
RKE2 patch releases wait 3 days after release.
A cluster must move to a new minor release first, so minor and major updates are held until the owner approves them on the dependency dashboard.
